# ElevenLabs in Early Talks for 2027 Funding at $33 Billion Value

By Tom Mackenzie, Yazhou Sun, Natasha Mascarenhas, and Rebecca Torrence

November 25, 2026 at 6:24 PM UTC

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

ElevenLabs, an artificial intelligence company focused on realistic-sounding voices, is in early discussions for a funding round at a target valuation of $33 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

The company plans to kick off the efforts in the first three months of 2027, the people said, asking not to be identified as the information isn’t public. Discussions are preliminary, though some investors are pushing for the process to start sooner, they said.
